HediffDef.label: artisan
HediffDef.description: This person is a certified artisan: a master of one craft, recognized by the colony.\n\nArtisans learn their specialty faster, sometimes make items a quality level better, and are inspired more often. In return they expect more from life, want a decent workshop, and dislike menial work.

HediffDef.label: scholar
HediffDef.description: This person is a certified scholar: learned in research, dark study or medicine, and recognized by the colony.\n\nScholars learn their field faster, work better in it, and are inspired more often. In return they expect more from life, want an impressive room to work in, and dislike menial work.

HediffDef.label: soldier
HediffDef.description: This person serves the colony as a soldier. Soldiers stand with citizens, but expect as little as commoners.\n\nSoldiers learn Shooting and Melee faster, are paid like commoners and pay no taxes. In return their other skills stop improving at a cap, and they dislike skilled labor like crafting, study and doctoring.

HediffDef.label: noble
HediffDef.description: This person belongs to the colony's nobility.\n\nNobles are better traders and negotiators, and a content noble lifts the spirits of lower castes nearby. In return they expect a great deal, need a private and impressive bedroom, refuse menial work, and need their standing upheld.

li.label: sky-high artisan expectations
li.description: We live in luxury, and I hold everything to the standard of my craft. Nothing here is quite good enough.

li.label: high artisan expectations
li.description: We're well off. A craftsman of my standing expects fine tools and a fine life.

li.label: moderate artisan expectations
li.description: We're comfortable, but I know what good work and a good life look like.

li.label: low artisan expectations
li.description: We have modest means. I can make do, though my craft deserves better.

li.label: very low artisan expectations
li.description: We're poor. I expect little, but I still take pride in my work.

li.label: extremely low artisan expectations
li.description: We have almost nothing. Anything I make is a small victory.

li.label: noble artisan expectations
li.description: My position raises what I expect, and my craft raises it further.

li.label: royal artisan expectations
li.description: My exalted position, and my craft, demand the very best.

li.label: elite artisan expectations
li.description: My position raises what I expect, and my craft raises it further.

li.label: supreme artisan expectations
li.description: My exalted position, and my craft, demand the very best.

li.label: sky-high scholar expectations
li.description: We live in luxury, and I've read enough to know it could still be better. Nothing here is quite good enough.

li.label: high scholar expectations
li.description: We're well off. A learned person of my standing expects a fine library and a fine life.

li.label: moderate scholar expectations
li.description: We're comfortable, but I know how much more a well-run colony could offer.

li.label: low scholar expectations
li.description: We have modest means. I can make do, though my studies deserve better.

li.label: very low scholar expectations
li.description: We're poor. I expect little, but knowledge is worth having anyway.

li.label: extremely low scholar expectations
li.description: We have almost nothing. Anything I learn here is a small victory.

li.label: noble scholar expectations
li.description: My position raises what I expect, and my learning raises it further.

li.label: royal scholar expectations
li.description: My exalted position, and my learning, demand the very best.

li.label: elite scholar expectations
li.description: My position raises what I expect, and my learning raises it further.

li.label: supreme scholar expectations
li.description: My exalted position, and my learning, demand the very best.

li.label: sky-high noble expectations
li.description: Even this opulence is barely fitting for one of my rank.

li.label: high noble expectations
li.description: We're wealthy, as a noble house should be. I expect to be treated accordingly.

li.label: moderate noble expectations
li.description: We're comfortable, but a noble expects more than comfort.

li.label: low noble expectations
li.description: This colony is modest. It's hardly fitting for nobility.

li.label: very low noble expectations
li.description: We're poor. A noble shouldn't have to live like this, but I'll endure.

li.label: extremely low noble expectations
li.description: We have nothing. Even a noble can't expect much from nothing.

li.label: noble expectations
li.description: My rank demands the finest of everything.

li.label: royal noble expectations
li.description: My rank is exalted, and I expect to be treated so.

li.label: elite noble expectations
li.description: My rank demands the finest of everything.

li.label: supreme noble expectations
li.description: My rank is exalted, and I expect to be treated so.

li.label: want to rise
li.description: I deserve more than this station. Others have climbed higher, and so should I.

li.label: menial work
li.description: I'm a trained artisan, and they have me doing menial chores. That's beneath my station.

li.label: my finest work
li.description: I made something truly exceptional. This is what my craft is for.

li.label: shabby workshop
li.description: How am I supposed to do my best work in a place like this? A craftsman needs a proper workshop.

li.label: cramped study
li.description: How am I supposed to think clearly in a place like this? A scholar needs a proper room to work in.

li.label: not a soldier's work
li.description: I signed up to fight, not to fiddle with benches and books.

li.label: sour lord nearby
li.description: One of our nobles is in a foul mood, and everyone around them feels it.

li.label: under a noble's eye
li.description: A noble is nearby, keeping things in order.

li.label: good lordship
li.description: A gracious noble is nearby. It feels like someone is looking out for us.

li.label: inspiring lordship
li.description: A truly inspiring noble is nearby. Working under them makes me proud.

li.label: sleeping among commoners
li.description: A noble shouldn't share sleeping quarters like a laborer. I need a bedroom of my own.

li.label: quarters beneath my rank
li.description: My bedroom is plain. It's no place for a noble.

NeedDef.label: standing
NeedDef.description: A noble's sense that the colony gives them their due. It drops over time.\n\nIt rises when lower castes talk with the noble, when the noble takes part in rituals (most of all as the organizer), and slowly while the noble owns a fine bedroom. Insults from lower castes lower it.

li.label: humiliated
li.description: Nobody in this colony treats me like a noble anymore. It's humiliating.

li.label: slighted
li.description: I'm not getting the respect my rank deserves.

li.label: respected
li.description: The colony gives me my due. This is how a noble should be treated.
